mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_order ( order_id, reservation_id, user_id, item_name, quantity, total_amount, status, payment_type ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{reservationId}, #{userId}, #{itemName}, #{quantity}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{paymentType} )
mapper.update: UPDATE profile_tbl SET membership_type = #{membershipType}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE payment_order SET status = #{status}, approved_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'APPROVED' THEN SYSDATE ELSE approved_at END WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.select: SELECT order_id AS orderId, reservation_id AS reservationId, user_id AS userId, item_name AS itemName, quantity AS quantity, total_amount AS totalAmount, tid AS tid, status AS status, payment_type AS paymentType, created_at AS createdAt, approved_at AS approvedAt, fail_reason AS failReason FROM payment_order WHERE order_id = #{value}
mapper.update: UPDATE profile_tbl SET membership_type = 'FREE', updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE user_id = #{value}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ticket_payment_tbl ( order_id, seat_id, show_id, schedule_id, ticket_price, ticket_status, created_at, canceled_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{seatId}, #{showId}, #{scheduleId}, #{ticketPrice}, #{ticketStatus}, SYSDATE, NULL )
mapper.select: SELECT order_id AS orderId, seat_id AS seatId, show_id AS showId, schedule_id AS scheduleId, ticket_price AS ticketPrice, ticket_status AS ticketStatus, created_at AS createdAt, canceled_at AS canceledAt FROM ticket_payment_tbl WHERE order_id = #{value} ORDER BY seat_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket_payment_tbl SET ticket_status = 'CANCEL', canceled_at = SYSDATE WHERE order_id = #{value}
